title: [finding] The "maintainer 2026-08-27: no alias, no deprecation window" ruling cited by #16483 and PR #16665 cannot be located, and its date contradicts the "same week" prose that cites it
body:
Raised by the **at-tier (`fable`) contract review** of PR #16665 (finding F1), dispatched by the `domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024). Filed by that seat. Unassigned, bare, for triage.

⛔ **This card does not decide the ruling, and nothing here questions the retirement itself.** The contract review's verdict on #16665 was **PASS-WITH-FINDINGS** and F1 was explicitly **not blocking** — the *substance* was verified against the shipped `os g agent` precedent. What cannot be verified is the **citation**.

## The claim

#16483 and PR #16665 both attribute the no-alias / no-deprecation-window decision to a **maintainer ruling of 2026-08-27**. That attribution has propagated into six places:

- the card body (#16483)
- PR #16665's body
- `packages/cli/src/commands/create.ts:13-14`
- the header of `packages/cli/test/create-example-retired.e2e.test.ts`
- `.changeset/os-create-example-retired.md`
- the retirement callout in `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`

## ⚠️ It could not be found — searched, not assumed

The reviewer searched:

- **all six comments on #15531** — the batch #66 ruling (director seat, 2026-09-07, option B, comment `5564757555`) says verbatim only *"Retire `os create example` (a weaker `os init` plus a README) — #16483"*. No alias or window language.
- **all 200 comments on ledger #12708** — the batch #66 row matches #15531 and carries no alias/window language. ⭐ **The ledger's earliest comment is 2026-08-30, so it cannot carry an 2026-08-27 ruling at all.**
- **the head tree** (`AGENTS.md`, `docs/`, `.claude/`, `scripts/pm`, `.changeset/`, `packages/cli/src`, `content/docs`) for "deprecation window" and "2026-08-27". Every 2026-08-27 ruling found is about something else: #12473, #12509, #12579, #12599, #12667, #12278, #11982, objectui#6262.

## ⭐ Two internal tensions — one statement is wrong whichever way this resolves

1. **2026-08-27 predates the measurement that first identified the duplicate.** The `os create example` / `os init` convergence was measured by PR #15797 on **2026-09-05**. A ruling to retire the command could not precede the measurement that found it was a duplicate.
2. **`create.ts:13-14` and the e2e header say the maintainer "ruled the same week" as #15531**, which is dated **2026-09-07**. 2026-08-27 is not that week.

⇒ The date and the "same week" prose cannot both be right.

## What is being asked

**Confirm the ruling and its date.** Then the "same week" prose in `create.ts` and `create-example-retired.e2e.test.ts` should be corrected to the real date.

## ⚠️ What has already been done, so this is not re-done

PR #16665's dev has been instructed by the PM seat to make the citation **assert only what is verifiable** — cite the #15531 batch #66 ruling (verified verbatim by the review) and record the alias/no-window provenance as *recorded on card #16483, pending maintainer confirmation*, dropping the unsupported date and the "same week" phrasing.

⛔ The **runtime message** was deliberately left alone: *"There is no alias and no deprecation window"* describes what the code does and is true regardless of who ruled it. Only the provenance claims were narrowed.

⇒ So the PR does not ship the unverifiable date. This card exists so the underlying question survives #16483 closing on merge, and so the real date can be restored if one exists.

## Why it is worth a card rather than a shrug

This repo's whole `os create example` retirement is about a statement that outlived its truth. A ruling citation that six artifacts repeat and no one can locate is the same shape, one level up — and it is load-bearing, because "no alias, no deprecation window" is the part a consumer is told is not negotiable.

Refs: PR #16665 · #16483 · #15531 (batch #66, comment `5564757555`) · #12708 (ledger) · PR #15797 (the 2026-09-05 measurement).
